links.outcome: Factual accuracy, completeness, usefulness of RAG vs standalone LLM on radiology guideline queries
links.effect: Both RAG systems significantly outperformed standalone LLM; enhanced RAG factual accuracy 0.89 vs 0.68, completeness 4.20 vs 3.05, usefulness 3.99 vs 3.09 (5-point Likert).
links.quote: Both RAG systems significantly outperformed the standalone LLM in all metrics, with the enhanced model achieving the highest scores: Factual accuracy (0.89 vs. 0.68), completeness (4.20 vs. 3.05 on a 5-point Likert scale), and usefulness (3.99 vs. 3.09 on a 5-point Likert scale).

screen.practice: retrieval grounding added to an LLM
screen.reason: Evaluates whether adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding to a standalone LLM improves factual accuracy, completeness, and clinical usefulness on clinical radiology guideline queries.
